reason: Byron chose diagram quality as the lead job, then asked for all the work and a merge when CI passed.
follow_ups: Decide whether docs/research/diagram-library-gaps-2026-10-27/run.md stays public.

title: Embedding ecosystem
summary: The native runtime, SVG policy, viewer, <draft-diagram> element, remark and markdown-it adapters, and Astro, Docusaurus and VitePress recipes shipped in the stack from PR #422 to PR #456. Planning and Pro assets are archived at 525e8807.
reason: Byron asked for one clean consumer story and docs, then a merge of the whole stack.
follow_ups: Create the @draftably npm organization, publish both packages once, and add trusted publishers before merging Version Packages.
Trim the runtime's public options (limits, cancellation, nonce, provenance) before 1.0.
Decide whether the viewer needs its worker and its own SVG sanitizer.
Merge the four package proof scripts and the duplicate viewer examples.
Explore items EMB-017 to EMB-020: VS Code preview, custom iframe, Kroki, native host proposals.

title: Interactive links and emphasis states
summary: Links (a ↗ mark that opens URLs as written, .draft files in the viewer and file paths in the editor from the git root), the config line with link-base and editor, check suggestions for missing files, static SVG links, and emphasis states (state lines, --state, --states panels and the viewer's state chips) shipped in PR 140 to PR 145 on 2026-10-27, with PR 189 and PR 198 after. The hover chip became the mark as the open button, and PR 441 later removed hover tooltips. Reconciled against f1c6a981; the planning files are at 51269c20.
reason: Byron approved retirement on 2026-11-10 after a check found the work already shipped while the map still said planned.
follow_ups: Several diagrams at once (multi-file sheets or boards, overlays) stays a later question from Byron's memo; start a new initiative when wanted.
Optional: show a link's target without hover tooltips (for example in the status bar on selection), since PR 441 removed the hover tooltip that named it.
Below the cut line, not planned: editing states in the viewer, captions and playback, tags, per-state camera, a project-wide config file, rewriting SVG links for any output folder.

title: Diagram themes and stronger default styles
summary: Five themes, numeric shades, custom families, bundled fonts and the Appearance menu shipped in PR 30 (22a53ba4, 9d9a1331) on 2026-10-15. The palette study then renamed graphite, mulberry and midnight to drafting, ink and blueprint (9faadcab), and PR 551 (10e1ade5, draftably 0.14.0) added drafting-dark for dark pages. Reconciled against origin/main 20835652 with no local code changes. The planning files are at 20835652.
reason: Byron asked on 2026-11-12 to retire plans that are actually done into durable docs. All three milestones are on origin/main.
follow_ups: No textured theme shipped. The texture study's recipe and rules are archived through docs/research/README.md; start a new initiative if wanted.
Known palette limits (teal vs green, blue vs violet under protanopia, brown Blueprint 900 for amber and violet) are listed in docs/research/README.md.
Below the cut line, not planned: font uploads, remote fonts, per-node typography or padding, a full theme editor, brand extraction.
